verdict.rationale: The axis applies: a government service's public guidance pages could reasonably be open to keyless agents. However, the latest dated probe (2026-10-07) found that aima.gov.pt fails TLS certificate verification for a standard keyless client, so nothing on the host could be fetched. An earlier 2026-10-06 dossier had seen an open robots.txt and a 200 landing page, but that was the same pipeline's own observation, not a vendor claim, and current hands-on evidence shows the reading surface is not reachable.

support.subject: As an AI-native founder, the service's published guidance pages are reachable by a keyless agent with a standard identified user agent — no bot wall, JS-only shell, or CAPTCHA in front of the public reading surface
